description.value: Lakeside BC Parks campground at the north end of Christina Lake — reputed one of Canada's warmest and clearest — with pocket beaches, short trails to the water, and a Monashee Mountains backdrop. Fully reservable with 63 sites, showers, and flush toilets; accessed via paved Hwy 3 and closed by a seasonal gate in fall.
